messages:
alana: Uploaded the PRD draft for Dedicated Capacity acceptance tests: https://redwood.docs/prd/dedicated-capacity-2141590000
alana: Main asks: confirm SLA targets, throughput sizing methodology, autoscale acceptance criteria, and edge-case regressions we gate on.
mike: Quick read — one ask: we need explicit workload curves. Are we sizing to steady-state QPS or 99th-percentile burst? :thinking_face:
mike: Proposal: two profiles — steady (70% of commit, long-run) and burst (3x steady for 60s). Use p95 latency on steady and p99 on burst for alerts.
raj: From infra perspective:
- warm_pool_min = max(1, floor(0.2 * committed_gpus))
- cold_start_time measured = 18-22s for quantized pipeline
- autoscale_trigger: sustained queue length > 50 for 15s => scale up
- autoscale_cooldown: 90s
raj: Need the PRD to call out warm pool warming strategy and a fallback policy when scale-up time would violate SLA.
jess: Customer asks clarified yesterday: Enterprise customers want "no more than 1% failed requests monthly" and a 99.9% availability SLO for control-plane ops. That maps to SLA but we need to decide penalties vs. credits. Also they want a canary fallback to hosted model on degradation.
alana: Good — add a section for contractual fallbacks. We should also state acceptance thresholds:
```
Acceptance test (per-customer commit):
1) Run 2h steady at target QPS => p95 latency <= 250ms, error_rate <= 0.5%
2) Run 10x burst (60s windows) => p99 latency <= 1.0s, no more than 2% requests dropped
3) Force node OOM/eviction => fallback to hosted variant within 45s and traffic rerouted
4) Quality gate: eval set top-1 accuracy drop <= 2% vs baseline
```
mike: That looks good. Minor: change p95 latency window to 5m rolling. Also add metric tags: model, quantization, seq_len, gpu_type.
raj: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- Partial pool degradation (50% of GPUs offline) => ensure graceful degradation matrix
- KV cache warmup for long-chat workloads (cache-hit ratio target >= 60% after 5 exchanges)
- Mixed model routing: prefer lower-cost variant if quality within threshold
jess: Add governance for rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on error_rate > 1% in 15m.
alana: SRE bot, please log this thread to the PRD ticket as duties/notes.
sre-bot: Logged: PRD-2141590000 — Added infra notes, acceptance criteria, and rollout policy. :white_check_mark:
mike: One more: include a short test harness snippet for load testing in the repo. e.g.
```
# run-locust.sh --model gpt-open-quant --qps 500 --duration 2h --seq 512
```
alana: Action items:
- mike: add metric tagging and load harness examples (by EOD)
- raj: draft warm-pool and autoscale knobs + degradation matrix (tomorrow)
- jess: draft contractual fallback wording and SLA phrasing (security review after)
- I'll update PRD with acceptance tests & link to eval dataset
alana: Thanks all :thumbsup:
